name: Combo B1 + OBV + Bins + FlipGuard methods
description: Full spec for Combo B1 core, OBV_soft75 filter, bin-based wagering, and FlipGuard (strict and relaxed) with fee-aware betting.

dataset.name: DB_epoch_ochlv_merged_call15s.csv
dataset.description: Epoch-level BTC 5-minute prediction dataset with OCHLV+approx_priceDifference merged at epoch anchors.

anchor_row_definition.description: One anchor row per epoch (previousEpoch), taken as the LAST row for that epoch from the merged OCHLV+epoch table.

EMA240.description: 240-tick EMA of Close over the full OCHLV stream (not just anchors).
EMA240.anchor_value: At each anchor Timestamp, take the EMA240 from the underlying stream row with the matching Timestamp.

EMA240_slope.description: First difference of EMA240 over underlying stream, then attached to anchor rows by Timestamp.

VWAP_5m.description: 5-minute VWAP window aligned to anchor Timestamp t.
VWAP_5m.window: All OCHLV ticks with Timestamp in [t-5min, t].
VWAP_5m.equation: VWAP_5m(t) = sum_i( Close_i * Volume_i ) / sum_i( Volume_i ) over the 5-minute window.

VWAP_drift.description: Relative drift of anchor close vs 5m VWAP.

OBV.description: On-Balance Volume on the full OCHLV stream.
equation: If Close_t > Close_{t-1}: OBV_t = OBV_{t-1} + Volume_t
If Close_t < Close_{t-1}: OBV_t = OBV_{t-1} - Volume_t
OBV.anchor_value: At each anchor Timestamp, take OBV from the underlying stream row with the matching Timestamp.

OBV_slope.description: First difference of OBV over the stream, then attached to anchors by Timestamp.

plateau_flag.description: Marks whether the last 5 minutes are relatively flat.
plateau_flag.window: All OCHLV ticks with Timestamp in [t-5min, t].
equation: range_ratio(t) = (max(Close_i) - min(Close_i)) / VWAP_5m(t) over the window
Compute thr_range = median(range_ratio over all anchor rows).

flip_flag.description: Detects changes in label direction between consecutive epochs.
equation: flip_t = True if label_{t-1} != 0, label_t != 0 and label_t != label_{t-1}, else False.

gaussian_smoothing.description: Causal Gaussian smoothing of anchor Close series, used for FlipGuard curvature.
gaussian_smoothing.kernel: For sigma (σ), take radius r = floor(3σ). Define x = -r, ..., +r. kernel(x) = exp(-0.5 * (x/σ)^2). Normalize kernel so sum(kernel) = 1.
gaussian_smoothing.boundary: Pad the series at both ends with edge values (mode='edge') before convolution.
gaussian_smoothing.equation: gσ = conv( padded Close, kernel ) with 'valid' mode, aligned back to the original indices.

gaussian_slopes.alignment: Attach gS1, gM1 directly to anchor rows by index (same ordering as smoothed series).

B1_EMA_VWAP.name: Combo B1 core classifier
B1_EMA_VWAP.notes: EMA240 slope is primary; VWAP drift sign confirms weak EMA regimes.
logic: If ema_abs >= 0.4: predict ema_sign (Bull if >0, Bear if <0).
If ema_sign != 0 and ema_sign == vwap_drift_sign: predict ema_sign.

OBV_soft75_filter.name: OBV conflict veto (soft75)
OBV_soft75_filter.notes: Veto trades in weak EMA regimes where OBV strongly disagrees with B1.
calibration: Let abs_obv = |OBV_slope| over all anchor rows.
logic: If ema_abs is NaN OR ema_abs >= 0.4: predict pred_B1 (skip OBV veto in strong EMA regimes).

binning_and_wager.name: Bin-based confidence + bet sizing
binning_and_wager.notes: Bins defined on EMA strength, VWAP strength, plateau/flip status, and OBV alignment.

ema_bin.quantiles: q1 = 0.33-quantile, q2 = 0.66-quantile of ema_abs among pred_OBV != 0 rows.

calibration_logic: Consider rows where bin_OBV == b and pred_OBV != 0.
Let n_b = number of such rows.
bet_fraction.usage: Per trade, bet_fraction_base = bin_bet_frac[bin_OBV]; bet_amt_base = BASE_BET * bet_fraction_base if pred != 0, else 0.

scope_bin.description: FlipGuard only operates in the weakest bin: weak EMA, weak VWAP, plateau, flip.

vwap_floor.description: Minimum VWAP_drift magnitude required to consider a flip trade in the weak/weak/plateau/flip bin.

v1_0_strict.name: FlipGuard strict
v1_0_strict.notes: VWAP floor plus spike hard-veto and soft down-weighting.
logic: Only apply if in scope_bin and pred_OBV != 0.
v1_0_strict.outside_scope: If not in scope_bin: pred_FG = pred_OBV, weight_FG = 1.0.

v1_1_relaxed.name: FlipGuard relaxed
v1_1_relaxed.notes: VWAP floor + only soft down-weight; no spike hard-veto. Designed to preserve more raw PnL while still cleaning junk.
logic: Only apply if in scope_bin and pred_OBV != 0.
v1_1_relaxed.outside_scope: If not in scope_bin: pred_FG_relaxed = pred_OBV, weight_FG_relaxed = 1.0.

Combo_B1_OBV_bins_baseline_fee015.name: Combo B1 + OBV_soft75 + bin-based wagering (no FlipGuard)
Combo_B1_OBV_bins_baseline_fee015.description: Core Combo B1 classifier filtered by OBV_soft75, with bin-based confidence wager. Base bet 0.015 BNB, 8% fee on wins, 2% fee on losses.

payout_model: If trade wins: pnl = bet_amt * (1 - FEE_WIN).
per_trade_bet: bet_fraction = bin_bet_frac[bin] (precomputed from this dataset as described).
bet_amt = BASE_BET * bet_fraction if pred != 0, else 0.

prediction_pipeline: Else: compute bins and bin_OBV, then bet_amt_base and pnl_base with fees as in betting section.

Combo_B1_OBV_bins_FlipGuard_strict_fee01.name: Combo B1 + OBV_soft75 + bins + FlipGuard strict
Combo_B1_OBV_bins_FlipGuard_strict_fee01.description: Same as baseline, but add FlipGuard v1.0 strict in the weak/weak/plateau/flip bin. Uses weight_FG_strict to scale bets.

payout_model: If trade wins: pnl = bet_amt_FG_strict * (1 - FEE_WIN).
per_trade_bet: Compute bin_OBV and base bet_fraction = bin_bet_frac[bin_OBV].
Apply FlipGuard.v1_0_strict to get pred_FG_strict and weight_FG_strict.

prediction_pipeline: Compute shared_features and core predictions as baseline.
Apply FlipGuard strict only in weak/weak/plateau/flip bin.
Use pred_FG_strict and weight_FG_strict for bets and pnl.

Combo_B1_OBV_bins_FlipGuard_relaxed_fee0.name: Combo B1 + OBV_soft75 + bins + FlipGuard relaxed
Combo_B1_OBV_bins_FlipGuard_relaxed_fee0.description: Same as baseline, but add FlipGuard v1.1 relaxed in the weak/weak/plateau/flip bin. VWAP floor still enforced; spike regions down-weighted instead of hard-vetoed.

per_trade_bet: Compute bin_OBV and base bet_fraction = bin_bet_frac[bin_OBV].
Apply FlipGuard.v1_1_relaxed to get pred_FG_relaxed and weight_FG_relaxed.
Else: bet_frac_FG_relaxed = bet_fraction * weight_FG_relaxed (0.5 in slope-warning region, 1.0 otherwise).
payout_model: If trade wins: pnl = bet_amt_FG_relaxed * (1 - FEE_WIN).

prediction_pipeline: Compute shared_features and core predictions as baseline.
Apply FlipGuard relaxed only in weak/weak/plateau/flip bin.
Use pred_FG_relaxed and weight_FG_relaxed for bets and pnl.
